name: Feed triage
description: Nightly RSS digest by email. Deterministic everywhere except the summaries: the send guard is an edge, marking items read is structurally after a confirmed send, and the watchdog is the on_missed policy.

summarize.prompt:
Summarize each feed item below in 1-2 sentences, written from its `content` field: what it is about and the key takeaway. Do not invent facts that are not in the content, and do not rank, reorder or drop items.

If an item has `truncated: true` and its content is too thin to summarize honestly, run `/Users/ruiyiz/.local/bin/feeds content <id> --fetch` to read the full article first.

Return one entry per item under `summaries`, keyed by the item's `id`.

{{json nodes.prep.output}}

batch.expr:
({
  created_at: run.started_at,
  run_id: run.id,
  wait_node: 'ask',
  thread_id: nodes.send.output.threadId,
  message_id: nodes.send.output.id,
  items: nodes.compose.output.batch.items,
})

ask.prompt: Reply to the digest email with: save 1 4 / summarize 7 / dismiss 2 / next

act.prompt:
The user answered this run's digest. Apply their reply to THIS run's batch and nothing else.

Their reply:
{{json nodes.ask.output.response}}

This run's batch — numbers resolve against `n` here, never against the batch file on disk, which a later digest may already have overwritten:
{{json nodes.batch.output}}

Actions, all reversible, so just do them:
- save N: `/Users/ruiyiz/.local/bin/feeds star <id>`, then append a note (title, URL, date, one-line summary) to /Users/ruiyiz/Vault/ruiyiz/inbox/feeds/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md
- summarize N: `/Users/ruiyiz/.local/bin/feeds content <id>` (add --fetch if the content looks truncated) and write the summary into your reply
- dismiss N: no action, it is only a negative-interest signal
- next: serve the next batch by the same rules the nightly digest uses

A number with no matching `n` in the batch above: say so, do not guess.

Then send the confirmation on the same email thread, in one command:
  /Users/ruiyiz/.bun/bin/gws gmail +reply --message-id {{nodes.batch.output.message_id}} --from {{q inputs.from}} --body <your html> --html

Report what you did in one line (e.g. "saved 1,4 · summarized 7 · dismissed 2"). Do not call send_message; the emailed reply above is the whole delivery.

caught_up.cmd:
/Users/ruiyiz/.bun/bin/gws gmail +send --to {{q inputs.to}} --from {{q inputs.from}} --subject 'Feeds: all caught up' --body '

Feeds: all caught up. 🎉

' --html
